releaseNotes:
## AgentOS 2.0.0-beta.12

- Added signed offline Core upgrade import to System settings, including streamed upload, safe archive inspection, embedded manifest signature verification, platform and architecture checks, exact size and SHA-256 validation, and reuse of the existing install-and-restart flow
- Extended the bootstrap installer with `--core`, `--runtime`, and `--offline` inputs so disconnected hosts can install from separate verified archives or one self-contained AgentOS offline bundle without network access
- Added a release packager for target-specific offline bundles containing the signed channel manifest, matching Core archive, and optional pinned local AgentOS Runtime archive
- Kept online signed-channel upgrades and persistent data behavior unchanged, while retaining AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.3` so this Core-only update does not republish or redownload unchanged Runtime artifacts

### Verification

- Passed the complete 265-test TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK suite after a production build
- Passed all 10 Java 8 SDK tests and built the `2.0.0-beta.12` SDK JAR
- Passed the Sandbox VMM Go test suite
- Assembled and checksum-verified the signed macOS arm64 Core archive, audited its allowlisted contents, and installed it in an isolated prefix
- Verified online update compatibility plus valid, invalid, mismatched, and duplicate offline installer and in-product import paths
